summary.text: Paul Wikstrom is the Republican nominee in Minnesota's 4th Congressional District. An engineering manager from Shoreview, he lost a 2025 special election for Minnesota House District 40B. He says he is running on stopping government fraud, affordability and jobs.

paragraphs.text: According to his Ballotpedia survey, Paul Wikstrom grew up in Montana and North Dakota, graduated from Dickinson High School, and moved to Minnesota as a young adult.
He earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Minnesota, Twin Cities, and a graduate degree from the University of St. Thomas.
He says he worked in seismic exploration, road construction and farming before becoming an engineer, and he currently works as an engineering manager.
He also says he is a certified flight instructor and active pilot who has flown medical volunteer missions, and that he coached youth soccer for more than 10 years.

Wikstrom says he has been a Republican grassroots leader for more than 25 years, convening caucuses, chairing conventions and supporting campaigns, and that he contested a candidate's eligibility in 2024.
He lost the March 11, 2025 special general election for Minnesota House District 40B to David Gottfried (D), 70.2%-29.8%.
He has been married 30 years and raised three children in Shoreview, Minnesota.
